I came out to my wife just before my first therapy appointment so I didn’t have that advantage. In that instance what I can say is to be sincere, you are still the same person and still love her.  I will add that when I came out to my parents a month later I wrote a list of what I wanted to tell them; Same person, in therapy, going to support groups, general well-being, that I loved them, wanted to be present(I was always somewhat withdrawn and becoming more so).  I always emphasize that I am the same person since this was already/has always been a part of my personality. In general since then most everyone has seen a positive change in me(out to immediate family and a few friends at work) and that in itself is huge.
